title: Purchase Limits of Singapore Saving Bonds
what_it_is: Purchase Limits of Singapore Saving Bonds

sections.label: Singapore Savings Bonds holdings
sections.summary: More than 40,000 individuals hold over $1.1 billion of Singapore Savings Bonds in aggregate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: More than 40,000 individuals now hold over $1.1 billion of Singapore Savings Bonds in aggregate.

sections.label: SRS use and Savings Bond limits
sections.summary: Using SRS monies for Savings Bonds is being studied, and current issue and overall limits are not cast in stone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Mr Patrick Tay has asked if Supplementary Retirement Scheme (SRS) monies can be used to purchase Savings Bonds.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: This is an idea we are open to and have been studying.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: As of now, the additional benefits are not clear since SRS monies can already be invested in Singapore Government Securities, which offer the same returns as Savings Bonds, if held to maturity.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Currently, the maximum investment amount for each Savings Bond issue, or "issue limit", is $50,000 and the maximum individual holding, or "overall limit", is $100,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The current limits are not cast in stone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: However, so far, only a small minority of Savings Bond investors have reached the boundaries of these limits.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Only one in five applicants, on average, requests for the maximum of $50,000 of a given issue.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Less than 7% of investors are near or have reached the $100,000 overall limit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: We will monitor the take-up for some time before considering whether raising the limits would benefit a broad proportion of savers.
